title: Safety Features and Engineering
summary: Feedback on safety-related engineering centers on appreciation for the G70’s safety features and alerts, while a smaller set of reviews describe nonfunctioning features or safety concerns and many mentions lack enough context for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s overall feeling of safety, breadth of safety features, alert improvements, and strong engineering package.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe safety features not functioning as expected and concerns that a possible problem could be safety-related.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention safety systems, equipment, operating logic, desired clearer instructions, or safety worries without enough context to confirm a clear opinion.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short or lack context, so many safety mentions cannot be classified beyond undetermined.
The topic includes both concrete safety feature feedback and broader safety-related worries, which limits how specifically the cluster can be summarized.
